decisions_of_record: The flip-gated rating behavior is UNCHANGED — the operator ordered the mis-citation fixed, not the interaction model re-derived; the SME-faithful rate-before-flip affordance stays a flagged product decision (documented in the corrected comments).

SME's per-lesson scope family is NOT representable in the SyllabAI corpus (every deck is one subtopic; the section slug is topic-level and constant per deck; specPointCode is null across the pilot) — cardType ships as the honest deck-internal scope axis instead, and the deviation is documented in code and here.
The due axis is exposed as its own filter checkbox (OR-ed over the state axis) — SyllabAI's computed analogue of SME's Revisit bucket, whose trigger upstream was logged unconfirmed in pass 5.

Resume is device-scoped on purpose (matches the honesty chip's account/device disclosure and the local-overlay source of truth); a per-account resume needs a core surface (DC-8 full parity) and is left for a core-side lane.
Saved runs restore only under strict set-equality with today's deck — a corpus wave discards the session rather than resuming a run that would silently hide or phantom cards.
Ratings never re-filter a live run (snapshot semantics) — a learner-composed query is not yanked out from under the card being viewed; the next structural action re-queries.
